name: SpecClip - Product Clipper for Interior Designers
description: Clip products to your Google Sheets spec book. Simplified multi-project support - one setup for all your SpecBooks!

permissions_justification.activeTab: Required to access the current webpage content to extract product information (name, price, images, dimensions) when the user clicks 'Pick from page' or uses the element picker.
permissions_justification.scripting: Required to inject the content script that enables the element picker and floating panel functionality for selecting product details from any webpage.
permissions_justification.storage: Required to save user settings (Google Apps Script URL, projects, sheet names, default quantity) and remember the selected project across browser sessions.
permissions_justification.notifications: Required to show success/error notifications when products are saved to Google Sheets, providing immediate feedback without requiring the user to keep the popup open.
